title: Wheel packaging omission of non-code asset directories without __init__.py and importlib.resources fallback
finding: Non-code directories like skills/ lacked an __init__.py, were omitted from pyproject.toml [tool.setuptools.packages.find] and [tool.setuptools.package-data], and PlatformAdapter.get_source_skills() only checked self.workspace / 'skills' without an importlib.resources.files('skills') fallback, causing standalone pip-installed wheels to silently return [] outside git checkouts.
prevention: Every bundled asset directory (rules/, skills/) must contain an __init__.py, be declared in pyproject.toml packages.find and package-data, resolve via importlib.resources.files() when workspace paths are absent, and be asserted by wheel_smoke.py running under python -I outside the repository.

title: Burn-before-compare invariant for single-use cryptographic receipts
finding: Validating caller-supplied file_digest, rule_digest, or file paths before recording the HMAC receipt nonce in the durable ledger allows an attacker or buggy caller to trigger a pre-burn ValueError or digest mismatch exception and replay the unburned single-use receipt.
prevention: Under sidecar lock .aegis/locks/receipts.lock, ReceiptManager.verify(..., consume=True) must verify HMAC signature and expiry first, immediately append the consumed nonce to .aegis/receipts.jsonl, and only then compare file_digest and rule_digest; ledger compaction must only prune expired nonces (exp < now).

title: Git worktree parent metadata preservation before deleting legacy repository checkouts
finding: Deleting a legacy repository directory (e.g., ~/Documents/soma) while the active agent session CWD is inside an attached git worktree (.git/worktrees/<name>) orphans the worktree's .git gitdir pointer and invalidates CWD inodes, causing subsequent subprocess calls to fail with ENOENT.
prevention: Before purging a parent git checkout, inspect git worktree links, copy .git/worktrees/<name> into the replacement repository's .git/worktrees/ directory, update the worktree .git pointer file, and run git worktree repair.
